newsitem.title: USA: Mafia figure in book/tv deal.
newsitem.headline: Mafia figure in book/tv deal.

text.p: He's a high-school dropout, a killer and the Mafia turncoat whose testimony helped send mob boss John Giotti to jail for life.
And soon, Salvatore (Sammy Bull) Gravano will be able to add a book and television special to his resume as special projects completed while in the Federal witness protection program.

ABC News said Monday that it will air a "Turning Point" interview with Gravano conducted by Diane Sawyer probably in the spring to coincide with the publication of a book he has collaborated on with Peter Maas, the author of the bestsellers "Serpico" and "The Valachi Papers."
Gravano, a self-confessed mob killer of 19 people, testified against Gotti, then the boss of the Gambino crime family, five years ago and helped get him convicted after three previous trials failed.
The New York Daily News said that Gravano signed a six-figure book deal and has been talking extensively with Maas, but has "total editorial control" over the book. It did not identify the publisher.
Maas was not immediately available for comment.
